newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds sees improved mid-protein demand.
newsitem.headline: European feeds sees improved mid-protein demand.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw improved demand for mid-protein products this afternoon, but most of the business was done for nearby material, market sources said.
"We saw more demand for mid-protein products as the market seemed to rise from an earlier bottom, the winter is nearing and consumers seem to be no fully covered yet," one broker said.

Argentine sunmeal pellets traded around $2 up from yesterday at $155 a tonne fob Rotterdam for spot material, afloat and Sept at $150 Oct at $152.50 and both Oct/Dec and Jan/March at $157 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Sept/Oct-Feb/March and Nov/Dec Malaysian palkernel expellers changed hands at $113 a tonne cif Rotterdam, the same price was paid for Oct citruspulp pellets.
Thai hard tapioca pellets traded slightly up from yesterday on fears of delayed shipments from the origin as high inland water levels could hamper loading of sea-going vessels.
Afloat and Dec tapioca traded at 21 marks per 100 kg fob Rotterdam and Jan/July at 20.75 marks.

Brazilian soymeal pellets changed hands at $292 a tonne cif Rotterdam, unchanged from yesterday. Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $273.50 a tonne cif Rotterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
